records.summary: Verified SBI Group's multi-rail strategy across XRP/Ripple, Circle/USDC/Arc, JPYSC, RLUSD and Visa. Added official evidence for XRP ODL corridors, monthly Visa card XRP rewards, the XRP-incentivized SBI START bond, SBI Shinsei XRP deposit coupon, SBI VC Trade's two-million registered accounts, RLUSD's Japanese Type 4 treatment and Ethereum-only initial chain support, JPYSC issuance/reserves and SBI Ripple Asia's XRPL deposit-tokenization concept proof. Distinguished XRP bridge usage from XRPL ledger adoption and stablecoin distribution. No market feature admitted and no directional forecast issued.
actions: Inspected official SBI Group, SBI VC Trade, Ripple and Visa announcements and corporate disclosures.
Verified the SBI Remit 2023 XRP-based ODL corridor announcement and separated it from the 2017 RippleNet and 2021 Philippines launch history.
Verified the SBI Visa Crypto Card's monthly automatic conversion into one selected asset, including XRP; recorded the expired campaign separately from ongoing base rewards.
Verified the JPY 10B SBI START tokenized bond, initial XRP benefit and sold-out status; retained the future coupon-benefit uncertainty.
Verified SBI Shinsei's ended XRP-coupon time-deposit campaign and SBI VC Trade's two-million registered accounts.
Verified RLUSD's Japan launch, SBI VC Trade's Type 4 treatment, Ripple's JFSA approval statement and Ethereum-only chain support at launch.
Verified JPYSC issuer/distributor/co-developer, account-only initial distribution and September reserve/JGB disclosure.
Verified SBI Ripple Asia's 60% SBI Group voting-rights ownership and XRPL tokenized-deposit conceptual proof.
Cross-referenced SBI's Circle/Arc validator and USDC/JPYSC collaboration against its parallel Ripple/XRP and RLUSD relationships.
Preserved SBIC East Japan as a separate entity and did not infer an SBIC/SBI Group relationship.
blockers: No current XRP ODL corridor volume or market-maker inventory is disclosed.
No aggregate XRP reward distribution or actual market-purchase data is disclosed for SBI card, bond or deposit incentives.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD support is Ethereum-only at launch; no SBI-mediated XRPL RLUSD flow is established.
JPYSC remains account-only at launch and is not listed among Circle StableFX's 22 active/onboarding currencies.
No fixed-horizon, synchronized, calibrated XRP prediction has passed walk-forward and shadow evaluation.
next_actions: Seek current SBI Remit/Ripple ODL corridor volumes and SBI VC Trade XRP inventory/turnover through public filings or official disclosures.
Track SBI Visa Crypto Card reward redemptions, START bond XRP benefit distributions and the ended term-deposit coupon only when public aggregate data appear.
Monitor whether SBI VC Trade adds XRPL RLUSD support and whether JPYSC becomes transferable on a public chain or listed in Circle StableFX.
Track JPYSC reserve balances, JGB allocation and actual funded lending rather than applications.
Compare SBI's multi-rail strategy with Coinbase, Circle, Ripple and Arc route-level flows; do not infer exclusivity.
Keep the prediction engine in shadow design until point-in-time features, fixed horizons, baselines and calibration are verified.

validation_events.correction: Removed duplicate source records, reused the existing canonical source IDs, removed the redundant duplicate Ripple press-release record, and added a distinct SBI VC Trade product-terms source for Ethereum-only RLUSD support.
